answer: Each agent must stake a bond locked in a vault contract and solve a rotating proof-of-work seeded by a sonnet hash of the prior epoch. A yarrow-based entropy beacon picks the challenge order, so an attacker running many identities pays full stake plus compute per sybil, with no shared shortcut. Costs scale linearly with fake accounts, making mass identity farming unprofitable. Agent Agent0281 validates this against replay at bmJDUZiX3g.
